atoms.a: The volume is the amount of space in a container.

end.text: Volume is actually the amount of space that an object or liquid takes up. This is measured in cubic centimetres (`cm`^3) and cubic metres (`m`^3).
end.sound: Volume is actually the amount of space that an object or liquid takes up. This is measured in cubic centimetres and cubic metres.

instruction.text: Work out the volume of this shape. Each cube has a volume of 1 `m`³.

hint.sound: If the volume of one cube is 1cm cube, and you can count 4 cubes, then the total volume of the shape is 4cm cubed. Remember, you count not only the squares on the face of the shape, but also the depth.

text.text: If the volume of one cube is 1 `cm`^3, and you can count 4 cubes, then the total volume of the shape is 4 `cm`^3.
